metrics.note: aragora (badge), aragora-debate (root build), aragora-sdk (sdk/python).
Root package ships no CLI entry point while INSTALL.md documents `aragora serve`.

Distinct whole packages (module pattern exactly aragora.<pkg>.*, which mypy also applies to the package __init__) in the grow-only [[tool.mypy.overrides]] list with check_untyped_defs = true; single-module overrides do not count, and a package drops out when any override for it or a module inside it sets check_untyped_defs = false or ignore_errors = true. packages is the only-grow floor and value must equal its length: scripts/report_code_quality.py --check (required lint job) fails when a listed package leaves the measured set, and reports new packages so they can be added here. Seeded 2026-10-11 on main 66c804cb4f with caching, events, protocols, resilience, shared, types and utils (was 0): each has zero .mypy-baseline entries and no check_untyped_defs errors under mypy 2.1.0 and 2.4.0, in both the CI changed-file form (--follow-imports=skip) and the full-tree form.

Enrolled packages (the mypy_check_untyped_defs_packages set) that no [tool.ruff.lint] per-file-ignores or extend-per-file-ignores key exempts from BLE001 or G004, including broad keys such as aragora/* and selector prefixes such as BLE, G or ALL; 0 when either code is not selected or is ignored globally. packages is the only-grow floor, enforced by scripts/report_code_quality.py --check like the mypy metric. The value follows the mypy enrollment because the package-wide aragora/* BLE001/G004 ignore was removed in #10491; it drops below the mypy count only if a carve-out returns for an enrolled package (was 0).

Unordered pairs of aragora modules that directly import each other (mutual 2-cycles), with TYPE_CHECKING-guarded imports EXCLUDED (type-only imports are not runtime cycles; including them inflates the count to 183). Pinned by scripts/ci/measure_import_graph.py and ratcheted shrink-only via its --check mode against scripts/baselines/import_cycles_baseline.json. Target <30 (P4b).
Distinct top-level aragora packages outside aragora.server that directly import the aragora.server subtree (grimp). Pinned by scripts/ci/measure_import_graph.py. Target <=5 (P4b).
Python files directly in the aragora/server/handlers/ root; equals 'ls aragora/server/handlers/*.py | wc -l'. Pinned by scripts/ci/measure_import_graph.py. Target <20 (P4b).

Pre-migration pytest collection total, pinned BEFORE the P1 tests-root->subdir migration (VAL-P1-009 path B floor). The migration is rename-only (git mv loose tests/*.py into shard-referenced mirrored subdirs), so the post-migration collect-only total must never drop below this value.
